mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mold_specs ( id, mold_id, dimensions, material, cavity_count, design_life_cycles, design_life_years, key_dimensions, linked_documents ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{moldId}, #{dimensions}, #{material}, #{cavityCount}, #{designLifeCycles}, #{designLifeYears}, #{keyDimensions}, #{linkedDocuments} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, mold_id, dimensions, material, cavity_count, design_life_cycles, design_life_years, key_dimensions, linked_documents FROM mold_specs WHERE mold_id = #{moldId}
